---
title: "3 · Common rules"
---

Tiers, evidence flags and cuts of posterior rankings can be interpreted as ordered grade reports.
Each rule states some directions and withholds others, permitting evaluation under a common posterior and loss.
[Fixed quantile tiers](fixed-tiers.qmd) separate the disclosure determined by group sizes from the expected errors
of their assignments. [Matched-disclosure comparisons](rule-comparison.qmd) place these rules relative to a
frontier in a specified family. Further applications consider [repeated-data stability](stability.qmd) and the
additional objectives and conventions required for [allocation or classification](one-place.qmd).
